//: Copy to appsettings.Server.json next to Reconza.Web.exe and fill in. This file is never overwritten by updates. Keep it private.

Database.//: MySql = a MySQL or MariaDB database created in Plesk. Sqlite = a file in App_Data, no setup.
Database.//AutoMigrate: true = the app creates/updates tables at start-up. false = you import reconza-database.sql in phpMyAdmin (recommended on MariaDB shared hosting).

ConnectionStrings.//: Plesk > Databases > Add Database (MySQL or MariaDB). Same server: keep SslMode=Preferred;AllowPublicKeyRetrieval=true. Remote server: use SslMode=Required and remove AllowPublicKeyRetrieval.

DataProtection.//: 32 random bytes, base64. Generate once (e.g. `openssl rand -base64 32` or PowerShell below) and back it up: losing it makes stored files unreadable.

Seo.//: Optional. Google Search Console > Add property > HTML tag: paste only the content="..." value. Cloudflare Web Analytics is cookieless (no consent banner).
